visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) The scene opens with a top-down view of a completed Japanese udon dish in a silver pot. A bright yellow raw egg yolk sits in the center, surrounded by cooked beef slices and udon noodles. A hand sprinkles chopped green onions over the dish. (2) The scene cuts to food preparation. A hand places raw shredded green cabbage into the bottom of a stainless steel pot. (3) Thinly sliced raw beef for hotpot is layered on top of the cabbage, followed by a bundle of white udon noodles. (4) Dark tonkatsu sauce is poured from a small glass bowl onto the beef using a spoon. (5) Light-colored dashi soy sauce and golden sesame oil are sequentially drizzled over the ingredients. (6) The pot is placed inside an electric steamer base. The cook's hand closes the silver lid. (7) After the lid is opened, the beef is cooked brown. The cook uses chopsticks to stir and incorporate the ingredients. (8) A raw egg yolk is dropped into the center of the pot. The cook rapidly stirs the yolk into the hot noodles. (9) The final phase shows close-up shots of the glistening noodles being lifted with chopsticks, with the broken egg yolk coating the beef and cabbage.
visual_base.text_narrative_log: (1) [Slogan]: 月見日式烏龍麵. [Logo]: wecook123. (2) [Slogan]: 材料. [Subtitle]: 高麗菜絲 100g. 火鍋牛肉片 100g. 烏龍麵 1包. (3) [Slogan]: 調味料. [Subtitle]: 豬排醬 40g. 柴魚醬油 40g. 香油 15g. (4) [Slogan]: 放入電鍋. (5) [Slogan]: 蒸煮8分鐘. (6) [Slogan]: 攪拌均勻. (7) [Slogan]: 加入1顆蛋黃.

audio_base.audio_narrative_log: (1) A sharp 'whoosh' sound effect triggers as the friendly male narrator begins speaking in an energetic, welcoming tone. Upbeat acoustic guitar BGM with a light drum beat starts immediately. (2) A soft rustling sound follows as the cabbage is placed in the pot. (3) A wet, squelching sound is audible as the raw beef slices are layered into the container. (4) A metallic 'clink' of a spoon against glass occurs, followed by the distinct sound of liquid splashing as the sauces are poured. (5) A hollow metallic 'thud' signals the pot hitting the steamer base, followed by a sharp click as the lid is secured. (6) A digital 'ding' sound effect transitions into the sound of steam or simmering. (7) The sound of the lid opening is followed by the high-frequency rhythmic scratching and clacking of wooden chopsticks stirring the noodles against the metal pot. (8) A soft, wet squelch occurs as the egg yolk is added and vigorously stirred, creating a creamy texture sound. (9) The narrator's voice rises in pitch and excitement during the final close-up lift, accompanied by the sounds of noodles sloshing.

narrative_and_purpose.mainPurpose: The video aims to teach viewers how to prepare a 'Moon-viewing' Japanese udon dish easily using only an electric steamer, emphasizing convenience for those who do not wish to use an open flame. It uses appetizing close-up visuals of the breaking egg yolk to create high sensory appeal.
